title: feat(web): add Pulse with a briefing page and a live header line
body:
Mockup D's Pulse: a briefing beside the inbox and a one-line pulse in the inbox header that opens it. Everything is derived from data the portal already caches; no polling added.

## What changed

- `/pulse` page, linked in the rail above Inbox. Sections: Since your last visit (new, resolved, now waiting on you, acted on by you), Stuck (waiting on the maintainer longer than 3 days, oldest first), This week per repository (triaged, needed you, acted on, median to verdict from the stats route).
- "Since your last visit" compares the open set against a per-user, per-workspace snapshot saved when the user leaves both the inbox and Pulse, on `pagehide` and on hiding the tab; moving between the inbox and Pulse, opening a PR, or a reload within ten minutes continues the visit. First visit says changes show from the next visit.
- Header pulse `N new · N resolved · N stuck · You N` (last part only when non-zero) with an aria-label, computed once in Layout and shared by context.
- `lib/pulse.ts` holds the count rules with tests; the moved stats helpers keep TriageStrip's output.

## Verification

- `bun run check`; `bun test apps/web` (count rules, visit continuation boundary).
- Browser pass on a local hub and portal: the Pulse page renders its three sections with real counts, a reload keeps the visit, and the header pulse links to Pulse.

Closes CL-XXXX
Closes CL-XXXX
